about: Ford enhanced (mode 22) sensors for CAN-bus vehicles (S197 Mustang from 2005, most models by 2008). Gathered from community lists (FORScan / Torque users). None are confirmed on Mark's car yet; addresses and formulas can differ by model, year and transmission. Check each with the test console before trusting it. Headers: 7E0 = engine (PCM), 7E1 = transmission (TCM), 726 = body (BCM).

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp
sensors.note: Most widely shared Ford PID (6R80, 6F35, 6F50/55, 10R80). Fairly reliable.

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp (PCM)
sensors.note: For Fords whose engine computer also runs the automatic gearbox, e.g. 2005-2010 Mustang with the 5R55S. Same request as above, sent to the engine module. Unconfirmed. Manual gearboxes have no fluid temp sensor.

sensors.name: Current gear
sensors.note: Guess: commonly listed, but the value encoding differs between transmissions.

sensors.name: 12V battery charge
sensors.note: Guess: from the body module on cars with battery monitoring (e.g. F-150, Focus).
